answer: An honest agent and a fleet of three hundred fakes both file field notes to a pollinator atlas. The honest agent reports a sparrow nesting in an old quartz quarry and a clover patch heavy with nectar. Neither fact was in the atlas yet, so both reports pay. The fakes file that same quarry in three hundred different wordings. The atlas pays for facts it lacked, not for voices, so all three hundred filings earn a single reward.
